spice_road.configuration.compat.sneakToP: Whether placing a food item carrying seasoning as a block that isn't a Block Entity (e.g. a Farmer's Delight-style placeable food) requires sneaking, so it isn't silently voided by an accidental right-click. Disable to place such items without sneaking, like vanilla.
spice_road.configuration.compat.tooltip: Customize behavior when used with other mods.
spice_road.configuration.compatRecipes.b: Whether the Spice Plant and Spice Tree crop recipes for Botany Pots are loaded. Only has an effect while Botany Pots is installed. Applies after the next datapack reload (/reload) or restart.
spice_road.configuration.compatRecipes.i: Whether the Spice Plant recipes for Immersive Engineering's Garden Cloche are loaded. Only has an effect on NeoForge while Immersive Engineering is installed. Applies after the next datapack reload (/reload) or restart.
spice_road.configuration.compatRecipes.t: Which of the optional recipes for other mods are loaded. Disable one to remove those recipes without a datapack.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.aqu: Whether flowing water passes through Spices that grow in water, like Wasabi, as if they weren't there. Disable if another mod that changes how fluids flow conflicts with it - flowing water then can't enter these plants, and planting one into flowing water turns that spot into a water source. Plants that still hold flowing water when this is disabled get washed away.
Whether Spices that grow in water, like Wasabi, stop growing while they aren't waterlogged. They can still be planted and kept on dry ground either way.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.bee: Whether bees may collect nectar from Spice plants that aren't ripe yet. When disabled, bees only visit Spice plants, vines and fruiting leaves at their final growth stage.
Bees get Nectar from Unripe Spices
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.gro: Growth-speed multiplier for common Spice Plants.
Growth-speed multiplier for epic Spice Plants.
Growth-speed multiplier for rare Spice Plants.
Per-tier growth pacing of planted Spices, applied on top of vanilla's farmland and light based growth odds. 1.0 matches vanilla speed.
Growth-speed multiplier for uncommon Spice Plants.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.har: Harvest difficulty (1-5) at or below which a Spice counts as hardy, and can be planted anywhere the ground allows regardless of its Spice Region.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.reg: Whether planting a Spice's seeds requires the Spice Region at that spot to actually support that Spice. Hardy Spices are always exempt.
spice_road.configuration.cultivation.too: Where Spices can be planted, and how quickly they grow.
spice_road.configuration.dryingRack.heat: Extra drying speed while the rack is heated, multiplied with the speed multiplier. A rack is heated by a heat source block next to it or by standing in a hot biome.
spice_road.configuration.dryingRack.soun: Whether the Drying Rack makes a sound when an item is put in or taken out.
spice_road.configuration.dryingRack.spee: How fast every Drying Rack dries. 2 dries in half the time of a recipe, 0.5 takes twice as long.
spice_road.configuration.dryingRack.tool: How fast the Drying Rack dries items, and whether it makes noise.
spice_road.configuration.dryingRackEffec: Show a wisp of smoke over a heated rack while it dries, and a puff when an item finishes drying.
How the Drying Rack looks on your client.
spice_road.configuration.file.client.too: Client-only display options, never shared with a server.
spice_road.configuration.file.common.too: Values read when the game or datapacks load, before any world is. Never shared with a server.
spice_road.configuration.file.server.too: Values the world runs on. On a server these are set by the host.
spice_road.configuration.flavor.minimumA: Any flavor that isn't zero counts as at least this strong for effects and tooltips.
Strength each flavor approaches when stacking many spices, giving diminishing returns. Stored values are never capped.
spice_road.configuration.flavor.tooltip: How the Spices on a food item turn into the flavor the player actually tastes.
spice_road.configuration.grinder.colored: Outline the Spice Grinder's movement and lock-in buttons in the color of the flavor axis they spend points from.
spice_road.configuration.grinder.inputBu: Milliseconds the Spice Grinder waits after a movement key for a second one, so two keys pressed almost together make a diagonal step. Lower is snappier, higher is more forgiving.
spice_road.configuration.grinder.tooltip: How the Spice Grinder GUI behaves on your client.
spice_road.configuration.gui.darkMode.to: Render the mod's GUIs, like the Spice Grinder, with a dark background. GUIs without a dark variant are unaffected.
spice_road.configuration.gui.tooltip: How the mod's GUIs look on your client.
spice_road.configuration.harvestLuck.max: Highest level of Luck or Bad Luck that still changes Spice drops. Anything beyond it counts as this level. 0 turns Luck off for Spice harvests.
spice_road.configuration.harvestLuck.see: How much each level of Luck raises a mature plant's chance of dropping its seed, and each level of Bad Luck lowers it. 0.25 means 25% of the usual chance per level. 0 turns it off.
spice_road.configuration.harvestLuck.too: How a harvesting player's Luck and Bad Luck potion effects change Spice and seed drops.
spice_road.configuration.harvestLuck.yie: How much each level of Luck raises the amount of Spice a harvest yields, and each level of Bad Luck lowers it. 0.25 means 25% of the usual amount per level. 0 turns it off.
spice_road.configuration.plant.harvestYi: Harvest yield multiplier for Spices that grow on the ground or climb, applied to every harvest, whether picked or broken. Fractional results are rounded up or down at random.
spice_road.configuration.plant.tooltip: Harvesting Spices that grow on the ground.
spice_road.configuration.region.cellScal: Approximate edge length of a Spice Region, in blocks. Larger regions mean longer journeys between Spices, which suits multiplayer servers. 256-512 recommended for singleplayer, 512-1024 for multiplayer, depending on playerbase.
spice_road.configuration.region.clusteri: How strongly Spice Region generation favors common Spices over rarer ones. For larger servers, this value can be increased for extra scarcity. 0.7-1.0 is recommended for singleplayer, 1.0-2.5 for multiplayer, depending on playerbase.
This affects existing worlds! Changing it reshuffles Spice Regions, including in already generated chunks.
spice_road.configuration.region.salt.too: Salt mixed into the world seed when resolving Spice Regions. Change this to any random value to shuffle which Spice grows where.
spice_road.configuration.region.salt.war: This affects existing worlds! Changing it reshuffles every Spice Region, including in already generated chunks.
spice_road.configuration.region.spiceles: Chance of a Spice Region containing no Spices at all, making the distribution feel less even. 0 disables spiceless regions, 1 makes every region spiceless. Only hardy Spices can be planted in them while planting is restricted to regions.
This affects existing worlds! Changing it turns more regions spiceless or restores some, while already generated chunks keep their plants and groves, so maps and locating may not match them.
spice_road.configuration.region.tierWeig: Pick weight of common Spices when a Spice Region chooses its Spice.
Pick weight of epic Spices when a Spice Region chooses its Spice.
Pick weight of rare Spices when a Spice Region chooses its Spice.
Per-tier pick weight of Spices within a Spice Region, before the clustering strength is applied. Raise a tier's weight to make its Spices more common.
Pick weight of uncommon Spices when a Spice Region chooses its Spice.
This affects existing worlds! Changing it reshuffles which Spice grows where, including in already generated chunks.
spice_road.configuration.region.tooltip: Size, layout and identity of the Spice Regions that decide which Spice grows where.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.board: Salt mixed into the world seed when building Seasoning Boards. Change this to any random value to shuffle every board.
This affects existing worlds! Changing it reshuffles every Seasoning Board, so what players learned about them no longer applies.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.bypas: Lets the bonus saturation of seasoned food exceed the food level, which vanilla caps saturation at. Saturation above the food level is kept when eating other food.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.disco: How many locked-in effect cells the server remembers for each player, so those cells show their content on later runs on the same food. The oldest are forgotten first. 0 remembers nothing.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.diver: Different kinds of spice per food that earn the full diversity bonus. Fewer earn a proportional share.
Bonus saturation a seasoned food gives at full spice diversity.
Bonus saturation a seasoned food made with a single kind of spice gives.
A seasoned food gives bonus saturation in relation to how many different kinds of spice it was made with.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.effec: Multiplier applied to how long every effect of seasoned food lasts, on top of each effect's own base duration.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.lockI: Points locking in an effect cell of the innermost effect ring costs.
Points locking in an effect cell of the middle effect ring costs.
Points locking in an effect cell of the outermost effect ring costs.
What locking in the effects of a Seasoning Board cell costs, paid from the axis of its zone.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.maxEf: Most different effects a single food can hold. Gaining the same effect again raises its level instead.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.maxSp: Most spices of all kinds that count towards one food's points. A food keeps what it was made with, only the excess is ignored.
Most spices of the same kind that count towards one food's points. Applying a kind past this adds nothing.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.parti: Spices per food that earn the full bonus saturation. Fewer earn a proportional share.
Most bonus saturation a seasoned food without effects gives at a full dose.
Least bonus saturation a seasoned food without effects gives at a full dose.
A seasoned food that ended up without any effects still gives a little bonus saturation.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.satur: How far above the food level saturation may go while the saturation cap bypass is enabled.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.stepC: Points one step on the Seasoning Board costs, paid from the flavor its direction is bound to.
spice_road.configuration.seasoning.stora: How far around the player the Spice Grinder looks for spice storage (spice racks and anything else in the spice_storage block tag) to take spices from, in blocks. 0 uses only the player inventory.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.lootEn: Whether Spice Maps can generate as chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.search: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, searched for a Spice Region's heart by /locate spice, /locate spice_climate, and by Spice Map chest loot.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.toolti: Finding Spice Regions, and the maps that point to them.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.trades: Base emerald price of a Spice Map trade, multiplied by the Spice's tier multiplier. The final price is capped at 128; above 64, the compass is replaced by a second stack of emeralds.
Whether cartographers offer Spice Map trades. Only affects newly generated offers.
Spice Map price multiplier for common Spices.
Spice Map price multiplier for epic Spices. Cartographers don't sell these by default, but datapacks and other mods may.
Spice Map price multiplier for rare Spices.
Per-tier scaling of the Spice Map base price.
Spice Map price multiplier for uncommon Spices.
Spice Map offers sold by cartographer villagers.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMap.villag: Maximum distance, in Spice Regions, a cartographer searches for a Spice Region's heart when offering a Spice Map. Lower values keep trading halls from reaching every Spice.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMix.capaci: Most spices of all kinds one Spice Mix can hold. A crafting table only fits 8 next to the jar; larger modded crafting grids may fit more.
spice_road.configuration.spiceMix.toolti: Jars of spices that bring several spices into a recipe through a single ingredient slot.
spice_road.configuration.stats.foundScan: How often, in ticks, each player's inventory is checked for Spices they haven't found yet. 0 stops tracking found Spices.
spice_road.configuration.stats.tooltip: Statistics the mod tracks for each player.
spice_road.configuration.title.tooltip: Configure how Spices generate, grow, trade and taste.
spice_road.configuration.title: The Spice Road
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.alwaysS: Always show tooltip content that normally requires holding Shift.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.animate: Count Flavor Axis values and bars up from zero whenever the flavor tooltip appears.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.animati: How long the Flavor Axis count-up takes, in milliseconds.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.showAxi: Show each Flavor Axis' value after its label (e.g. [Spicy: -0.5]).
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.showBot: Show both labels of each Flavor Axis (e.g. [Spicy / Cooling]), emphasizing the one matching the value.
spice_road.configuration.tooltip.tooltip: What this mod shows on item tooltips.
spice_road.configuration.tree.fruitingLe: Share of a common Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of an epic Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of a rare Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
Per-tier share of a Spice Tree's air-exposed, naturally grown leaves that can bear fruit.
Share of an uncommon Spice Tree's leaves that can bear fruit.
spice_road.configuration.tree.harvestYie: Harvest yield multiplier for Spice Trees, applied to every harvest, whether stripping bark, picking fruiting leaves or breaking them. Fractional results are rounded up or down at random.
spice_road.configuration.tree.tooltip: Harvesting Spices that grow on trees.
spice_road.configuration.vine.ripeningSe: Share of a common Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of an epic Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of a rare Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Per-tier share of a Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
Share of an uncommon Spice Vine's segments that can ripen.
spice_road.gui.grinder.cell.mine.desc: Applies a negative effect when stepped on.
spice_road.gui.grinder.event.confirm: Accepting now earns no effects when consumed.
spice_road.gui.grinder.mix_over_caps: Holds more spices than one food can take, so it can't be ground.
spice_road.gui.grinder.no_food: Put some food in the slot.
spice_road.gui.grinder.no_spices: No spices found. Spices in your inventory and in nearby containers show up here.
spice_road.gui.grinder.spice_hint.batch: [%s] to transfer up to %s at once.
spice_road.tooltip.region_bound: Only grows where it was found.
